axes.Y: grid north (EPSG:6576 grid north, meters; not true north)
axes.unity: Unity (x, y, z) = (X, Z, Y); Unity y is up

origin.method: area centroid of the OSM polygon computed in EPSG:6576, rounded to 0.01 ftUS
origin.ground_method: median NAVD88 height of LiDAR class-2 points within 3 m (horizontal)

horizontal.formula: X = (E - E0) * ftUS_m / k ; Y = (N - N0) * ftUS_m / k
horizontal.radius_method: GRS80 Gaussian mean radius sqrt(M*N) at the origin latitude
horizontal.geoid_note: GEOID18 grid not installed; approximate value for Nashville. 1 m error in h changes k by 1.6e-7 (0.016 mm per 100 m).

vertical.ground_source: raw/lidar/TN_DavidsonCounty_D22/EPT/TN_DavidsonCounty_D22_campus_ring_ept.laz (class 2, inside boundary + ring, duplicates included; EPT Z is meters)

tiles.name: T_<col>_<row>; each number = optional '-' then at least two digits of the absolute value (T_03_-02, T_-01_00)

sources.6576: E, N ftUS; Z NAVD88 ftUS (original D22 tiles)
sources.3857: web mercator m; Z NAVD88 m (D22 and 2011 EPT copies store Z in meters)
